end.parentNote: Asha used questions about hard soil, water, tunnels, and dead leaves to practise how soil animals help. Pihu connected worms with loosening soil and water moving down, but continued to say earthworms spoil soil and did not explain how dead leaves become rich soil. This mix-up was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a leaf and discuss how soil animals help break it down and make the soil richer.
